# Domain Gate Checklist: Game contract, registry, and persisted match

**Purpose**: Formal requirements-quality gate before `/speckit-tasks`, covering
the game contract and shell/game boundary, persistence and recovery, and the
match lifecycle.
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) ·
[data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness — Game contract and boundary

- [ ] CHK001 - Does the spec state the allowed value range for scores (integers only? negatives allowed? non-finite values forbidden?), or is it left to each game without saying so? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is it specified what must happen when a game's `scoreRound` omits a player or returns an extra player id? [Gap, Contract game-contract §GameDefinition]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the required fields of a round rejection (a stable code plus player-facing text) stated in the spec, or only in the contract document? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does the spec require registry ids to be unique and define what happens on a duplicate id? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the id format (kebab-case, equal to the folder name) a spec requirement, or only a contract convention? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Contract game-contract]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the minimum allowed `minPlayers` (1? 2?) specified, and is a single-player game intentionally in or out of scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Clarity — Game contract and boundary

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "shell code" defined precisely enough (which folders count as shell) for FR-010 to be checked without judgment calls? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are the forbidden patterns for "branching on a game's identity" listed exhaustively, or are the examples illustrative — and if illustrative, how is completeness verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "a tie" defined for each of the four rule functions, given that SC-002 requires a tie case for `validateRound` and `scoreRound` too, where a tie is not obviously meaningful? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are programming errors (bad static fields, duplicate ids) distinguished from player errors, so "never throws" (FR-003, FR-009, FR-020) is not read as covering both? [Clarity, Contract game-contract §defineGame]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the purity requirement explicit about module-level mutable state and about mutating the inputs passed in? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Does "each game MUST live in `src/games/<id>/`" (constitution II) conflict with fixture games living under `tests/fixtures/games/`, and is the exception stated in the spec rather than only in research? [Conflict, Spec §FR-025, Research D8]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does FR-020 list six discard cases while data-model lists seven load steps, and does SC-004 count the same set as FR-020? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §SC-004, Data-model §Load validation]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are FR-018 ("persisted before reported complete") and FR-021 (memory advances when the write fails) reconciled in the spec text, not only in the store contract? [Conflict, Spec §FR-018, §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is `renamePlayer` after a match is finished specified the same way in the spec (FR-013, Edge Cases) and in the data-model operation table? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "every player wins when there are zero rounds" stated consistently across Edge Cases, FR-004, and the contract's `resolveWinners` row — including for a lowest-wins game? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the name uniqueness rule (case-insensitive, accent-sensitive) stated in the spec, or does the spec say only "case-insensitive" while the accent rule lives in research? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Research D9]

## Scenario Coverage — Persistence and recovery

- [ ] CHK018 - Are requirements defined for two tabs or windows of the app open at once, both writing the same stored match? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the expected state after reload specified when the last write failed (the player sees the last successfully saved state, not the in-memory one)? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is it specified whether a later successful write after a failed one restores the full state (self-healing), or whether the failure is sticky? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the player informed when stored data is discarded on load, or is silent discard an explicit, documented decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-020, User Story 5]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is discarding data that carries a **newer** `schemaVersion` (e.g. after a deploy rollback) an explicit decision with its consequence stated? [Assumption, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for a stored draft round that is malformed while the rest of the match is valid (discard the draft only, or the whole match)? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the requirement that a draft must be serializable for storage stated in the spec, with the behavior when it is not? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is "initial state" defined (no current match) and is it specified that the discarded data is removed from storage, not just ignored? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]

## Scenario Coverage — Match lifecycle

- [ ] CHK026 - Is the round index for "replace a confirmed round" defined (zero- or one-based, valid range), and the error for an out-of-range index? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the effect on the draft round specified when a confirmed round is replaced or the last round is removed? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is it specified whether `confirmRound` clears the draft, and whether a rejected confirm keeps it? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the fate of the finished match specified when a rematch is created (replaced, with winners no longer available)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017a]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is it defined what "explicit discard" means for FR-011a in a phase with no screens — an operation the caller must invoke, with `createMatch` rejected otherwise? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011a]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are rejection reasons from a game's `validateRound` required to reach the caller unchanged on both confirm and replace? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Acceptance US3-1]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK032 - Are player name limits defined beyond "not blank": maximum length, internal repeated spaces, and invisible or control characters? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is renaming a player to their own current name (or to a case-variant of it) addressed by the uniqueness rule? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is creating a rematch addressed when the game has since been removed from the registry, or when its player limits changed so the old roster no longer fits? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-017a]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is it specified whether stored rounds are re-validated on load against the **current** player roster, so a renamed player does not invalidate a stored round? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-020]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK036 - Can SC-007 ("correct on every recomputation") be verified objectively — is there a reference expected result, or a definition of "correct" beyond "matches the game's rule"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is "0 differences" in SC-003 defined (structural equality of the stored match, including the draft)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is SC-006 ("no test game in the artifact") stated in terms that can be checked mechanically (e.g. by fixture id), and does it reach beyond `dist/index.html` to every emitted file? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Non-Functional Requirements, Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 - Is the absence of performance requirements an explicit decision (match size bounded by player limits and round count), rather than an omission? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are privacy expectations for player names stored on the device stated (local only, removed on discard), given that Principle I rules out a server? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the "no POC migration" assumption tied to a tracked dependency on the Phase 6 origin decision, so it is revisited if the origin stays the same? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK042 - Is the requirement that the store only be created in the browser (FR-024) backed by a check, given that the existing build guard only covers a page that does not import the store yet? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Traceability: 42 of 42 items carry a spec, contract, research, or data-model reference or a `[Gap]`/`[Conflict]`/`[Assumption]` marker.
